title: UPDATE  I had to trash the pitcher.
text:
UPDATE I had to trash the pitcher.. UPDATE~ UPDATE~ I used this pitcher faithfully, and didn't know when to change the filter, so I tried changing and could never get it back in. It was the blue filter and I tried and tried so I had to trash the pitcher.

I got this pitcher because my refrigerator needs water filter and those are expensive, plus they don't last too long. So, I do need to have filtered water and decided on this method. And, hopefully, the filters last long and are priced good.
This is a large pitcher, and I choose to have it on my counter where the coffee is. I drink from it all day, and use it for cooking and coffee. I don't need ice cold water, so I use it all day.

The one issue I have is that it DOES take a long time to fill up. And that must be because whatever you pour into it, takes time to go through the filter.

This is a nice, large plastic water pitcher. It is black on top of the clear plastic. Looks nice. I may get another one so I can keep one in the frigerator for hubby who likes cold water.

The electronic filter change indicator reminds you when to swap out the filter. Live the filtered life with Brita and enjoy a year of crisp and clean tasting water.
